projects.name: Project Type: ITSM Optimization & Integration
details: Team Size: 5
Description: Optimized ServiceNow incident management and SLA tracking to reduce resolution times and breaches, while
integrating the Service Catalog with Integration Hub and CMDB to automate asset record updates for provisioning requests,
aligned with ITIL best practices.
Roles and Responsibilities:
• Configured automated assignment rules and multi-stage workflows using Flow Designer to route incidents instantly.
• Established dynamic SLA definitions and built Performance Analytics dashboards to track team resolution bottlenecks.
• Designed a user-friendly Service Catalog with automated approval workflows for software and hardware requests.

projects.name: Project Type: ITSM Optimization & Integration
details: Team Size: 5
Description: Optimized ServiceNow incident management and SLA tracking to reduce resolution times and breaches, while
integrating the Service Catalog with Integration Hub and CMDB to automate asset record updates for provisioning requests,
aligned with ITIL best practices.
Roles and Responsibilities:
• Configured automated assignment rules and multi-stage workflows using Flow Designer to route incidents instantly.
• Established dynamic SLA definitions and built Performance Analytics dashboards to track team resolution bottlenecks.
• Designed a user-friendly Service Catalog with automated approval workflows for software and hardware requests.
